lesson: In under2camel, only uppercase the exact acronyms HTTP, API, SKU, and GDPR, leaving all other abbreviations like db, sql, and url title-cased.
why: The project style guide restricts uppercase acronyms to a specific set including domain terms and deliberately excludes standard tech terms like db, sql, and url.
quote: HTTP and API yes, but also SKU and GDPR (our domain ones). And we deliberately do NOT uppercase db, sql, or url
